history.note: live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend).

4.2.6-bbc-m8.label: better-borg-c milestone 8 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v8): 12 patch units since milestone 7 (patches 0078-0089), plus the owner's munchkin-by-class change (PR302). 4.2.6-bbc-munchkin-by-class shares that munchkin default (same 4 classes, depth 6) but not milestone 8's 12 fixes: it carries 76, this carries 88. Because the munchkin-by-class default is already in M8's game, the munchkin-wdr profile is a no-op on this specimen (confirmed identical play/trace hashes, 2026-11-09).

4.2.6-bbc-m9.label: better-borg-c milestone 9 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v9): 10 patch units since milestone 8 (patches 0090-0099: the 0090-0096 board batch and 0097-0099, including a memory-safety carry). C line only so far; borg-rs has not tagged a v9 yet.
